cards.text: The whole earth is under water, and one ark is floating with Noah, his family and the animals inside. Just waves in every direction. But God remembered Noah and all the animals and livestock that were with him in the ark.

cards.question: God remembers Noah out on the water. What does God send over the earth so the waters start going down?

cards.text: The springs of the deep and the floodgates of the heavens are closed, and the rain from the sky is held back. Like a 300-message group chat that FINALLY goes quiet.

cards.question: Once the rain is held back, the floodwaters are gone in a single day.

cards.text: On the seventeenth day of the seventh month, the ark stops drifting. BUMP. Every animal on board just lurched like the bus driver slammed the brakes.

cards.question: The ark comes to rest on the mountains of ___.

cards.text: The waters keep going down, month after month. Then on the first day of the tenth month, something besides water finally shows up out there.

cards.question: The waters keep going down. What becomes visible on the first day of the tenth month?

cards.text: After forty days, Noah opens the window he made in the ark. Out goes a raven.

cards.question: Noah sends a raven out the window of the ark. What does the raven do?

answers.text: It keeps flying back and forth
It stays perched on the roof

cards.text: Then Noah sends out a dove to see if the waters have gone down from the ground. A dove on a delivery run? Minty would be SO proud.

cards.question: Noah sends out the dove, but the waters are still covering the surface of all the earth. What happens to the dove?

answers.text: She finds nowhere to land and returns
She settles on a mountaintop to rest
She builds a nest in a tree

cards.text: So Noah reaches out his hand and brings her back inside the ark. A whole boat full of animals, and the man still makes time for one tired little bird.
Noah waits seven more days and sends the dove out again. And this time, she comes back to him in the evening carrying something.

cards.question: The dove comes back to Noah in the evening. What's in her beak?
Because of that olive leaf, Noah knew the waters had receded from the earth.

cards.text: Noah waits seven MORE days and sends her out one more time. Seven days, again? Friend, I can't wait seven minutes for my oven to preheat.

cards.question: Noah sends the dove out a third time. What happens?

cards.text: Big day on the ark, friend. In Noah's six hundred and first year, on the first day of the first month, Noah removes the covering from the ark. Then he takes a look outside.

cards.question: When Noah removes the covering from the ark, he sees that the surface of the ground is dry.

cards.text: By the twenty-seventh day of the second month, the earth is fully dry. Then God speaks to Noah.

cards.question: The earth is fully dry when God speaks to Noah. What does He tell Noah and his family to do?
God tells Noah to bring out the birds, the livestock and everything that crawls. Why does God want them out?

answers.text: So they can spread out and multiply
So Noah can count every one
So the ark can be taken apart

cards.text: So out they come, Noah's family and every creature, kind by kind. Then Noah builds an altar to the LORD.

cards.question: Noah offers burnt offerings on his new altar. Which animals and birds does he take them from?

answers.text: Only the ones born on the ark

cards.text: The LORD smells the pleasing aroma. And He says something in His heart.

cards.question: The LORD says in His heart that He will never again curse the ground because of man.
The LORD makes that promise even though He knows something about the human heart. What does He say about it?

answers.text: Every inclination of it is evil from youth
It grows wiser with every generation
It always turns back to Him in time

cards.text: Then the LORD says that as long as the earth endures, seedtime and harvest, cold and heat, summer and winter, day and night shall never cease. So morning is GUARANTEED, friend, and my snooze button has been arguing with that promise for years.
Then God blesses Noah and his sons. And He hands them their first job out here.

cards.question: God tells Noah and his sons to be fruitful and multiply and ___ the earth.

cards.text: God says every creature will fear and dread them, and everything that lives and moves will be food for them, just as He gave the green plants. But there's one catch.

cards.question: God gives Noah's family everything that lives and moves for food. What must they NOT eat?

answers.text: Meat with its lifeblood still in it
Meat from any bird of the air
Anything that swims in the sea

cards.text: Then God gets serious. He will demand an accounting from anyone who takes the life of his fellow man.

cards.question: God says whoever sheds the blood of man, by man his blood will be shed. Why does God treat human life this seriously?

answers.text: God made mankind in His own image
People were the last thing God made

cards.text: And God comes right back around: be fruitful and multiply, spread out across the earth and multiply upon it. Same blessing at the start and the end of the speech, friend. I think He wants that one to stick.
Then God speaks to Noah and his sons again, and this one is BIG. He says He is now establishing His covenant with them and their descendants after them.

cards.question: God's covenant here is only with Noah and his family, not with the animals that came out of the ark.
Noah's family just lived through the flood. What does God promise in His covenant with them?

answers.text: Never again a flood to destroy the earth
Never again forty days of rain
Never again any rain at all

cards.text: Then God says this covenant comes with a sign. Like signing a contract, except this signature is going to be HUGE.

cards.question: God gives a sign of His covenant. What does He set in the clouds?
God says this covenant is only meant to last for Noah's lifetime.

cards.text: Here's how it works. Whenever God forms clouds over the earth, and the rainbow appears in the clouds...

cards.question: Whenever the rainbow appears in the clouds, what does God say He will do?

cards.text: Notice who's doing the remembering: God says whenever the rainbow appears, He will see it and remember. Meanwhile I set three timers and STILL forget a tray in the oven.

cards.question: God calls this the ___ covenant between God and every living creature on the earth.

cards.text: So God tells Noah one more time: this is the sign of the covenant He has established between Him and every creature on the earth. Hold that rainbow in your mind, friend, because Noah's story isn't finished yet.
